marta: Heads-up — HF->Redwood conversion for model 'triad-v1' failed the smoke/eval runs. Generation truncates and we see KV cache shape mismatches.
marta: Quick root-cause glance: config.json contains a few unexpected shapes (rope_scaling as dict, missing sliding_window, explicit num_key_value_heads that doesn't align with num_attention_heads, and a huge max_position_embeddings).
leo: @marta can you paste the tiny offending snippet?
marta: ```json
{
  "num_attention_heads": 64,
  "num_key_value_heads": 32,
  "max_position_embeddings": 20480,
  "rope_scaling": {"type": "dynamic", "scale": 1.12}
}
```
sam: ok that explains the KV mismatch — our converter used heads as the source of truth and ended up allocating kv cache for 64 heads while HF indicated 32 kv heads, so runtime sees shape (layers,64,seq,hd) vs (layers,32,seq,hd).
vivian: missing sliding_window is also important — defaulting to no sliding window changes how we apply rope offsets for prefix tokens; can produce the weird "rope sliding" artifact near assistant prompts.
infra-bot: deploy-checker: conversion-triad-v1 job failed: e2e-quant-regression (seed=42). Log excerpt: `ERROR: KV cache shape mismatch (expected 64, got 32) -> aborting generation`
marta: Proposed converter changes:
1) prefer explicit num_key_value_heads if present; if absent infer but run sanity checks against num_attention_heads
2) normalize rope_scaling to a per-layer float array (accept dict variants), fallback to 1.0
3) treat missing sliding_window as 0 but emit a loud warning and link to docs
4) clamp max_position_embeddings to runtime maximum and emit truncation warnings
sam: sgtm. Please add unit tests for: a) kvheads < heads, b) rope_scaling as dict vs float, c) missing sliding_window combined with special tokens in chat template.
marta: Will do. I'll add a tiny reproducer and the failing prompt set from evals/regression/triad.json to the PR.
leo: Also add a quantized path test — 8-bit quantization hits a different reshape codepath and we saw a downstream OOB when kv dims mismatch.
vivian: FYI tokenizer quirk: triad-v1 uses a special token `<|assistant_beg|>` mapped to id 50256, but our chat template expects `<|assistant|>`. That mismatch + sliding_window absence caused an off-by-one in rope position application.
sam: Good catch. Add a tokenizer mapping check to the onboarding checklist.
marta: Draft PR opened: PR-4123 — includes converter fixes + smoke CI job `conv-config-smoke`. Assigning reviewers @leo @sam.
leo: Thanks. After PR lands let's run the full quant-regression and the new conv-config-smoke CI before we mark triad-v1 green.
vivian: I'll add a short note to model-onboarding docs listing required config fields and recommended normalizations.
sam: Postmortem item: update model onboarding checklist to require a small set of canonical config keys (num_key_value_heads, rope_scaling normalized, sliding_window default, special token mapping) to prevent future handoffs.
marta: Adding the failing logs and minimal reproducer to PR now. Will ping when CI is green. :white_check_mark:
